adjudication_note:
Round 2 of lexicon_pipeline run. Adjudication and adversarial refutation by AI nodes; every citation and example byte-verified against the corpus by the deterministic validator. Per-term reasons live in the run directory.
Refuted this round: alternativas (Fails COMMON-LANGUAGE and SENSE-VS-CITATIONS. The def stipulates the narrow deci); trair (Fails COMMON-LANGUAGE, LABELS and evidence integrity. The corpus uses the ordina); jogo (Fails SENSE-VS-CITATIONS outright: zero of the six supplied citations exhibit th); heurísticas (Fails ONE-SENSE. The corpus explicitly declares two types and the def only cover); julgamento (Fails SENSE-VS-CITATIONS and ONE-SENSE. The def restricts it to the structured e)

concepts.def: A criterion of comparison in a structured decision, the dimension along which each alternative is weighted and scored so that the options can be told apart.
neg_pt: A cor vibrante e o aroma cítrico são atributos que tornam o sabonete mais atraente na prateleira.
pos_pt: É justamente nesse ponto que os atributos de comparação entram em cena – são eles que tornam o julgamento possível.
Sem atributos, qualquer escolha será feita de maneira intuitiva, mesmo que todo o processo anterior tenha sido racional e bem estruturado.
concepts.source: reasoning corpus, adjudicated by an AI node under lexicon_pipeline, upheld by an independent adversarial refuter, citations byte-verified

concepts.def: A systematic distortion of perception or judgement, arising when a mental shortcut runs unchecked, that steers a decision away from the rational choice.
neg_pt: A costureira cortou o tecido no viés para que a saia caísse melhor no corpo.
pos_pt: Empresas exploram esse viés investindo na repetição constante de marcas e mensagens para criar uma sensação de confiança e familiaridade.
